messages:
Nadia: Promo blocked — staging rollout failing on image unpack. DeployBot auto-paused.

DeployBot: Promotion paused by deploy-bot at 3467778888. Reason: layer-read-eof on service-auth-staging. See https://ci.redwood/builds/19999 :no_entry_sign:

Ethan: Log from runner-12:
```
ERROR: failed to apply layer sha256:4f3a: unexpected EOF while reading compressed data
expected 5242880 bytes, got 3145728
```

storage-bot: Edge cache in us-west-2 returned increased 499s around 18:04 UTC. Storage ticket ST-1602 opened.

Nadia: Change window ~40m left. Options: 1) pin to last-good digest to unblock, 2) rebuild/push and wait for propagation, 3) purge cache (risky). Thoughts?

Ethan: Pin + parallel rebuild seems safest. I'll start rebuild with `REGISTRY_VALIDATE=1` and new cache key.

oncall-eng: If pinning, add rollback playbook and annotate release notes. Enable `image.unpack.errors` alert.

CI-Runner-Bot: `/ci retry builds/19999 --scope=image-unpack` queued (3 jobs).

Nadia: Manual promote command: `/deploy promote --env=staging --service=service-auth --digest=sha256:prevgood --reason="pin to known-good to meet cut window"` (2 approvals).

Ethan: +1. Starting rebuild/push with verify.

oncall-eng: +1

DeployBot: Promote executed: service-auth (staging) -> sha256:prevgood at 3467778930. Comment: pinned to unblock release window.

Ethan: Push finished, registry verify passed. Triggering `ci-artifact-verify` with `NO_CACHE=1`. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/verify-9001

CI-Runner-Bot: verify-9001 started on runners 3,7,12.

Nadia: Plan: pin now, verify in parallel, retarget when new digest verified. If verify fails we keep pin and escalate storage team.

CI-Runner-Bot: verify-9001 passed on all runners.

Ethan: Verified green. Will retarget canary after 8m smoke and then remove pin. Filing postmortem with storage team.

storage-bot: Assigned ST-1602 to storage-team to investigate edge node that served truncated layers.

Nadia: Unblock confirmed. Postmortem owners: Ethan (uploader) + storage-team. Release note: "Temporary pin to known-good image due to truncated registry layer; retarget planned after verified repush. See ST-1602." Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
